records.title: Thought Anchors: Which LLM Reasoning Steps Matter?
records.reason: The paper measures reasoning-sentence importance using perturbation, resampling and causal/attention analyses. It identifies influential 'thought anchors' and relationships, but does not itself implement token/step pruning or demonstrate serving savings; causal estimates and model/task coverage constrain deployment claims.

records.title: Wirelessly-Charged UHF Tags for Sensor Data Collection
records.reason: RFID sensor-tag charging and collection hardware is unrelated to LLM inference.

records.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
records.reason: Dataset of real-world coding-agent interactions, not an inference optimization.

records.title: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents
records.reason: Automated software-agent benchmark construction and decontamination, not an inference optimization.

records.title: Hindsight is 20/20: Building Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
records.reason: Hindsight combines memory retention, multi-channel retrieval/reranking and token-budget filtering with adaptive reasoning agents; experiments use long-term dialogue benchmarks. This may reduce prompt growth but the paper evaluates memory/agent quality rather than production inference serving latency or KV reuse.
